newsitem.title: USA: BTG Inc. wins $128 million government contract.
newsitem.headline: BTG Inc. wins $128 million government contract.

text.p: BTG Inc. said Wednesday it won a $128 million contract to modernise the U.S. State Department's world-wide communications infrastructure.
The programme is focused on the acquisition of computer hardware to replace current systems, but also has a significant requirement for software and maintenance services, the company said.
BTG, based in Fairfax, Va., provides information technology services and products to government and commercial clients.
